execute.description: rewrite "position" as rank keys ordered by the old numeric position
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."Card" AS t SET "position" = substr('0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', 19 + (r.i / 35)::int, 1) || substr('0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', 2 + (r.i % 35)::int, 1) FROM (SELECT "id", row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY "listId" ORDER BY "position"::float8, "id") - 1 AS i FROM "public"."Card") AS r WHERE t."id" = r."id"

postcheck.description: verify every "position" is a rank key
